articles.summary: Broadcasters in 550 markets, across 49 U.S. states, now have access to comprehensive, actionable radio audience data; expansion adds 1 million vehicles to the Portal’s measurement service, and feature set grows to include weekday and weekend station rankings The DTS AutoStage Broadcaster Portal has added 246 new U.S. markets, Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER) announced today. This brings the Portal’s total coverage to 550 markets across 49 states, including 173 previously under-measured small and mid-sized broadcast markets. The Portal has also expanded its feature set to include weekday and weekend station rankings as well as enhanced, ready-to-share reports for Premium tier users. Xperi will demonstrate the expanded Portal at the NAB Show New York, October 21-22, at the Javits Center, by appointment only. “Until now, reliable radio data has mostly been a ‘big-market’ advantage. articles.title: AutoStage Broadcaster Portal Adds 246 New Markets, Bringing Precise Radio Measurement to Previously Underserviced Areas

articles.summary: TiVo Ads Q2 2026 advertising and related revenue grew 54% year over year as advertisers increased engagement, app launches and audience reach across premium CTV experiences TiVo Ads today announced significant growth and momentum, with the TiVo One advertising platform surpassing 6.3 million monthly active users globally as of June 2026, a 70% year-over-year increase, while delivering record advertising and related revenue growth of 54% year over year in Q2 2026. The company also continued to expand its advertising inventory, audience data capabilities and distribution footprint as brands increasingly seek more effective ways to reach engaged television audiences. In one notable highlight, a leading global streaming platform’s TiVo Ads campaign increased monthly app launches by 70% as compared to the prior month, highlighting the effectiveness of reaching consumers directly during content discovery. articles.title: TiVo One Ad Platform Surpassed 6.3 Million Monthly Active Users, Delivered Record Q2 Revenue Growth and Expanded Global Advertising Footprint
